title: AiriBundle
description: AI-stack provenance carried in a NEXORA proof (package version 2). NON-NORMATIVE, as above. agent_public_key is what the PACKAGE SAYS signed the events — a claim, not an anchor. A verifier holding its own anchor for this agent MUST use that one; a mismatch is a finding, not a preference.

agent_public_key.description: Claimed signing key. See the description above.

events.description: One execution's events, in emission order. Order is load-bearing: the chain check exists to detect reordering. An empty array is refused rather than vacuously verified.
